findings.title: The e2e recovery effect transcript is red: lostRecord no longer spawns the git cat-file check for runs/
findings.detail:
`bun run test:e2e test/e2e/recovery.test.ts` fails 'a claim lost mid-run > effect transcript: spawns, port calls and runs/ files of both clones' (recovery.test.ts:157). The diff is one line missing from the transcript: `spawn repo-b $ git cat-file -e <sha:4>:.agents/specs/gh-9-add-search/runs`. That spawn came from the removed `git.hasPath(root, head, treeStoryRunStatePath(story))` after checkout.ts:250. AC4 says 'observe snapshots and effect transcripts are unchanged', and the Plan says 'any diff there is a finding to explain'. The handoff's Proof says 'No observe snapshot or transcript changed (unit tier green, nothing rewritten)', but transcripts run in the e2e tier, not the unit tier. CI's e2e tier would fail.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: This diff follows from user story 21 (branch-tree runs/ is never read). Rewrite the transcript with `NORN_TRANSCRIPT_UPDATE=1 bun run test:e2e test/e2e/recovery.test.ts`, check that the only change is this removed spawn, and explain it in the handoff's Proof next to AC4. Then confirm the whole e2e tier passes (`bun run test:e2e`; observe-snapshots already passes).

findings.title: A stale comment about base run state now sits above the superseded line
findings.detail:
The removed `base_run_state` spread left its comment '// Run state an older norn left on the base, pointed to `norn upgrade`' behind. It now describes the `superseded` line below it. The same leftover is at packages/view/src/load.ts:474. AGENTS.md: comments say why; this one now says something false.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Delete the comment in both places.

findings.title: Docs still describe the removed run-state move and status/doctor pointer
findings.detail:
docs/limitations.md:29 talks about 'since its run state was moved off the branch', a move norn no longer makes. docs/concepts.md:101 says 'A repository whose base branch still holds run state from an older norn is pointed to `norn upgrade`'. status and doctor no longer do this. The 0.30 refusal from slice 02 may cover it, so it is borderline.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Reword limitations.md:29 without the move. Make concepts.md:101 not imply a status or doctor warning, or leave it to slice 03's docs pass.
